body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: bddd6d7e49646a3e8d6dc08ce3738c34db04db40 -->
Ready for a maintainer to merge after the author marks this PR ready. No blocking findings.

I read the full diff and issue #3841. I checked the rules in upstream main's current AGENTS.md.

The change adds the original input move index to travel errors. It keeps the typed cause, axis, required angle, limits, and hint. Other errors pass through unchanged. The success path and standalone pose solver are unchanged.

**Local build and tests**

The trial merge used upstream main `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`. Its first parent is the full PR head above. The merge was clean.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 16 steps. It built both selected crates and passed 255 tests. No test failed. Four existing catalog tests remained ignored.

| Suite | Passed |
|---|---:|
| post lib | 150 |
| post ac_trunnion_ik | 7 |
| post ac_trunnion_path_safety | 13 |
| post g93_feed | 5 |
| post mach4_trunnion | 7 |
| app catalog_groove_part_off | 1 |
| app continuous_4axis_part | 10 |
| app example_catalog | 43 |
| app example_catalog_adaptive | 1 |
| app example_catalog_edge_work | 1 |
| app first_4axis_part | 4 |
| app first_part_programs | 2 |
| app first_router_part | 4 |
| app tilt_basis_compat | 7 |

The three new regression tests passed. They cover the initial pose, feed and rapid endpoints, and a failed subdivision. Earlier subdivisions do not change the reported input index.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

**Extra suites run**

`cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'` passed all five test steps. All 11 light tests passed:

- motion lib: 7 passed.
- motion adaptive_troch_island: 1 passed.
- motion adaptive_troch_neck: 1 passed.
- motion adaptive_troch_parallel: 1 passed.
- app pocket_pass_start: 1 passed.

This selects every light test. It omits only the broad build step; each test command builds its required binary.

The named catalog suites and recorded NC checks also passed in the quick gate. No fixture or importer changed, so no extra importer suite was required.

**Safety and goldens**

This change affects error reports only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry calculations, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. Safety mutations were not required and were not run. No golden or recorded program changed. No UI file changed.

**Requested before merge:** None.

Per the review request, I left the labels, title, draft state, and PR branch unchanged. The local review worktree and branch remain for the next review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 4098 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.
`merge-ready` set: the collaborator review of head `bddd6d7e4` is clean, the PR is ready (not a draft) and GitHub reports MERGEABLE. The label was not set when the review ran.
